title: Quests
description: Quests and the people who give them: quest offers, objectives (kill, collect, talk), turning in, experience and levelling (QuestSystem); clickable world objects, item nodes, doors, locks and escorts with ambushes (ObjectiveSystem); NPCs with daily routines, dialog topics, vendors, trainers, inns and pockets to pick (NpcSystem); story quests in stages, triggers, barks and books (StorySystem) with their journal and compass (StoryClientSystem); the world's saved memory, conditions and actions (QuestWorldStateSystem).
